patch.value:
## Context
The CLI maps the full stable Monica 4.x API, but freshness is currently established manually outside the product. Agents can inspect the bundled commit but cannot ask the CLI to verify whether that commit is still the current upstream 4.x head.

## Delivery
- Add an `api-research source-status` command backed by the official GitHub repository and branch metadata.
- Compare bundled repository, branch, commit, and route file provenance with the live upstream head without calling or mutating Monica CRM data.
- Emit deterministic, schema-validated TOON/JSON/YAML/table/Markdown output and offer a CI freshness gate.
- Keep network failures distinct from stale sources and return actionable agent commands.
- Update help, agent contracts, docs, package tooling, and read-only end-to-end coverage.

## Safety
No CRM endpoint or private payload is involved. The command reads only the public GitHub API and bundled reference metadata. Credentials, host data, and raw live CRM responses remain outside Git and PM.
Verify bundled Monica API source freshness

Add a machine-readable read-only command that verifies the checked-in Monica stable 4.x API snapshot against the current authoritative upstream branch so humans and agents can distinguish proven-current coverage from stale bundled evidence.

The CLI exposes documented api-research source-status help and machine output in every supported format; The command verifies the current monicahq/monica 4.x head against checked-in provenance and classifies current, stale, and unavailable states separately; --fail-on-stale exits 2 only for proven drift and preserves a structured payload; A registered output schema validates all source-status states and real CLI output; Agent catalogs and read-only E2E include the new command without enabling any mutation; Latest compatible pm-changelog is installed and latest global pm-cli use is documented without weakening npm peer resolution; Exact 100/100/100/100 coverage, 100 percent docstrings, all help leaves, package smoke, security, privacy, duplication, PM, and changelog gates pass; No private Monica data or credentials enter Git, PM history, logs, commits, or PR text
Authoritative upstream branch and snapshot provenance are identifiable; existing all-status PM lineage has been searched; local settings are read-only and private.
Continuously verifiable stable Monica API compatibility
Make API coverage freshness independently provable by the CLI
Prevents agents from treating a complete but stale API snapshot as current
Raises confidence in automation and future API parity work without touching CRM data
A schema-backed freshness verdict suitable for local use and CI
The latest research revalidated the snapshot manually, revealing that the proof is not yet executable by CLI consumers
Monica stable 4.x public GitHub repository; monica-cli 2026.7.24-2; Bun 1.3.11; Node 22+
Run monica api-research summary and inspect source metadata; there is no command that verifies the bundled commit against the current upstream 4.x head or fails CI when it drifts.
Agents can independently verify that the bundled API reference is current, stale, or temporarily unverifiable using a safe structured CLI command.
API parity is complete but freshness requires an external gh/browser check and has no published output schema or CI gate.
A future upstream route change could leave automation confidently using outdated coverage until a manual audit notices.
